name.description: The heading of the table column for a person's name in full, their first name and then their last.

firstName.description: The label of the field for a person's first name.

lastName.description: The label of the field for a person's last name, which the list is put in order by.

role.description: The label of the field, and the heading of the table column, for a person's role in the church: pastor, elder, staff or member.

title.description: The label of the field, and the heading of the table column, for what a person is called for what they do in the church, such as Worship Director.

titleHint.defaultMessage: Shown on the site in place of their role.
titleHint.description: The hint under the field for a person's title: where it is shown.

photo.description: The heading of the table column for the address of a person's photo.

picture.description: The label of the field for a person's photo, which is picked from the device and uploaded when the person is saved.

email.description: The label of the field for a person's email address.

phone.description: The label of the field for a person's phone number.

address.description: The label of the field, and the heading of the table column, for where a person lives: their postal address.

birthday.description: The label of the field, and the heading of the table column, for the day a person was born.

bio.description: The label of the rich text editor for a person's bio in full.

photoUpload.description: What the badge on a person's picture that picks an image as their photo does, shown under the pointer, when they have none.

photoChange.description: What the badge on a person's picture that picks an image to take their photo's place does, shown under the pointer.

photoRemove.description: The accessible name of the badge on a person's picture that removes their photo.

bioEmpty.description: What stands in for a person's bio when they have none: an invitation to click and start writing.
